answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in grove, verified in kernel, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 2 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the wharf check. A farm of 2020 identities would post 721 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
